posts.text: Western Digital ($WDC) raised its annual dividend from $0.60 to $0.70, a 16.7% increase seen on Oct 26. The company is flagged as 'at_risk' with a 5-year dividend growth of -23.3%.
Diageo ($DEO) cut its annual dividend by 39.8% from $3.32 to $2.00, seen on Oct 17. Despite the cut, the safety rating remains 'safe' with a 5-year growth of 2.6%.
The Clorox Company ($CLX) goes ex-dividend on Oct 28. It has a 23-year streak and a 5.72% yield, but is rated 'at_risk' with 5-year growth of 2.5%.
Nike ($NKE) currently yields 4.37%, which is 3.1 times its own 5-year average yield of 1.41%. The company has a 23-year dividend streak.
In the Basic Materials sector, 21 of 39 companies are rated 'safe', 6 are 'watch', and 12 are 'at_risk'. The median 5-year dividend growth is 5.9%.
PAX GLOBAL (0327.HK) cut its HKD annual dividend by 75.8% from 0.33 to 0.08, seen on Oct 23. It maintains a 'safe' rating despite the significant reduction.
Realty Income ($O) goes ex-dividend on Oct 30. With a 28-year streak and a 5.74% yield, it is rated 'safe' and pays monthly dividends.
